inference.analysis_population: completed primary runs; one paired perturbation per cell and seed
inference.contrasts: all three guard pairs within each cell and endpoint
inference.effect: paired mean difference in binary endpoint, guard_a minus guard_b
inference.effect_interval: paired percentile bootstrap over the 30 seed pairs
inference.limitation: The common velocity controller does not actively realize the guard's force allocation; contrasts estimate predictive classification error, not wrench-allocation tracking.
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three guard pairs within each cell and endpoint
inference.rates: per cell and guard with two-sided Wilson score intervals
secondary_endpoints: misclassification_rate = guard prediction differs from physical outcome
inference.test: exact two-sided McNemar test (conditional binomial on discordances)

paired_execution_repeatability.interpretation: repeatability of the same controller and world across guard labels
